title: Pressing enter in a searchbox reloads the page
body:
Steps to reproduce:
 - go to 
 - type something in the searchbar
 - press enter

Page is reloaded. The expected behavior is that the page should not be reloaded.

comments.body: This could happen if it's in a form and the js isn't loaded yet, but that is not the case here I think
That's what happened that's why I couldn't reproduce with a simple is.js v2 example.
